title: Senior Director, Software Engineering - Data and AI Platforms
description:
At **Epiq** , your work contributes to complex, global legal outcomes. You’ll join a values‑driven community where integrity guides decisions, **relentless service** sets the bar, and we **thrive on big challenges** together. We invest in your growth with enterprise‑wide learning and mobility. We celebrate who you are, and we respect life beyond work with flexibility that’s recognized externally. Enabled by modern platforms and AI, **you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career** and see your impact at scale.


**Job Description:**

**Role Description**

Epiq, the world’s leading Legal Solutions provider, is changing the legal tech game. We are looking for a Senior Director, Software Engineering – Data \& AI Platforms to expand data and information management capabilities across our organization. The successful candidate will help deliver our vision for our Data \& AI Platforms, working directly under the CTO, together with Product Management, Operations, AI/ML, and other stakeholders in the organization. The person will be a thought leader driving the Software Development function along with the Data Integration/Data Quality initiatives of the Epiq Service Cloud, including the data foundations that power our AI and GenAI capabilities, and a tremendous team player who builds connections across the organization.

  

  

This is still a hands\-on role, so we are looking for someone who can not only set our vision to advance this capability but also help implement it, leading a team of 80\- 100 people based primarily in India. The team is using a cloud\-native, modern technology stack built on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes, and PowerBI, with growing investment in streaming, Lakehouse, and GenAI/vector infrastructure, among other things. This is a leadership role and requires working in our office premises in a hybrid model.

  

  

**Responsibilities**

* Demonstrated hands\-on software engineering background (e.g., Python, Scala, or Java), with a track record of personally writing, reviewing, and shipping production\-grade code, not solely directing the work of others.
* Solid grounding in core engineering practices: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and formal code review standards.
* Experience designing and building APIs, services, and event\-driven/ microservices architectures that other engineering and product teams build on top of.
* Working knowledge of infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation) and containerized deployment (Docker/Kubernetes) from an ownership and architecture standpoint, not just as a consumer.
* Familiarity with secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices — dependency management, secrets management, and security review — particularly relevant given the sensitivity of legal data.
* Experience architecting for reliability and scale: observability (logging, monitoring, alerting), incident response, and performance/cost tuning of production data services.
* Develop a critical understanding of business data to proactively identify opportunities to improve data quality and deliver solutions and insights. Partner with AI/ML and Product teams to build the data foundations (pipelines, feature stores, vector search, RAG\-ready datasets) that power our GenAI and agentic product capabilities.
* Provide guidance for data integrity issues, ongoing maintenance, and data governance, including responsible\-AI data practices such as lineage tracking and PII/PHI handling appropriate for legal data.
* Maintain detailed documentation of data collection methods and dependencies.
* Work with key stakeholders to understand BI/Analytics and reporting requirements.
* Conduct audits and troubleshoot tracking gaps to maintain data confidence and implement data standardization practices.
* Support a data\-driven culture by educating the organization on everyday uses of data, and increasingly AI, as a resource.
* Work with our Data Science / Analytics organization to help achieve product goals, including supporting model evaluation and monitoring once in production.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study required.
* Master’s degree in a related field is highly desirable.
* Minimum of 15\-20 years of technology leadership experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience leading teams building data platforms.
* Understanding of machine learning, with prior experience implementing end\-toend ML\-powered models highly desirable; exposure to GenAI/LLM\-based systems (RAG, vector search, prompt/eval pipelines) is a strong plus.
* AWS/Azure cloud experience around data integration technologies and frameworks.
* Knowledge of common ingestion patterns, ETL/ELT, and streaming architectures.
* Hands\-on familiarity with modern data stack tooling (e.g., dbt, Spark/Databricksclass compute) and data observability/quality platforms.
* Proven experience working with large\-scale data processing platforms and distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Snowflake, or similar), handling high\-volume, high\-velocity data at enterprise scale.
* Working knowledge of data governance/cataloging tools and vector database concepts.
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies.
* Experience leading a Shared Services / Platform organization, with a client\-first mentality and a collaborative, helpful attitude.
* Experience managing distributed teams across India and global time zones, with strong stakeholder management across US/UK/EU counterparts.
* Track record of managing and growing remote teams over time, including hiring, mentoring, and building out organizational capability as scope expands.
* Expert knowledge of data warehousing concepts and data schemas.
* Awareness of data privacy and security regulations relevant to legal/regulated data (GDPR, CCPA, etc.) and how they intersect with AI system design.
* Prior experience in the legal industry or legal technology is a plus, though not required.
* High level of attention to detail, quality, and effective verbal and written communication skills along with excellent follow\-through.

**Epiq Leadership Compass**

**Enterprise Decision Making**

Applies deep business and financial insight to guide strategic decisions, resource allocation, and thought leadership.


* Use financial and market expertise for long\-term direction
* Build strategic partnerships
* Promote a customer\-first mindset
* Allocate global resources for innovation and growth

**Cultivates a Growth Mindset**

Fosters innovation through curiosity, smart risk\-taking, and adaptability—aligning change with strategy for lasting impact.


* Promote curiosity and forward\-thinking
* Build a culture of innovation through partnerships
* Drive innovation to meet client needs
* Lead innovation with a clear vision
* Align innovation with market trends

**Builds Talented Teams**

Builds and develops inclusive, high\-performing teams aligned to strategic goals for exceptional talent and business results.


* Focus on employee engagement
* Build a strong talent pipeline

**Fosters Relationships \& Collaboration**

Builds trust and alignment through open communication, shared goals, and strong partnerships to drive collective success.


* Build trust\-based partnerships
* Nurture long\-term relationships
* Remove collaboration barriers
* Celebrate cross\-team success

**Engages \& Influences**

Inspires action and alignment through clear communication, purposeful influence, and a compelling vision.


* Use storytelling to build buy\-in
* Align communication with organizational goals
* Guild alignment through strong engagement

**Maximizes Performance**

Sets and reinforces performance standards that drive results, ensure accountability, and align with Epiq’s goals.


* Use data to identify improvement opportunities
* Make informed decisions
* Align team goals with boarder strategy
* Empower teams to manage their own goals
* Translate vision into clear priorities
* Prepare for disruptions with strong change management

Epiq’s policy prohibits unlawful discrimination based on any of these impermissible bases, as well as any bases or grounds protected by applicable law in each jurisdiction. In addition Epiq will take affirmative action for minorities, women, covered veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. Epiq is pleased to provide such assistance and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request. Pursuant to relevant law, where applicable, Epiq will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.**

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Location:** India (IND)  

**Work Mode:** Remote  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  

**Experience Required:** 3–5 Years

**Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for a **Data Scientist with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience** to work on data science projects with a strong focus on **forecasting and predictive modeling**. The ideal candidate should have strong practical experience in **Python**, software development best practices, and building reliable and maintainable data science solutions. Experience with Azure\-based data and machine learning platforms will be an added advantage.

**1\. Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and maintain **data science solutions with a focus on forecasting use cases**.
* Analyze datasets to identify patterns, trends, and insights relevant to business requirements.
* Build, evaluate, and improve **forecasting and predictive models**.
* Prepare and transform data required for model development and analysis.
* Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
* Ensure developed solutions are reliable, maintainable, and suitable for deployment.
* Monitor model performance and support continuous improvement of existing forecasting solutions.
* Document models, methodologies, assumptions, and project outcomes.

**2\. Must\-Have Skills**
-------------------------

* **3–5 years of relevant hands\-on experience in Data Science.**
* **Strong hands\-on experience with Python** for data science and model development.
* **Hands\-on experience with forecasting and predictive modeling techniques.**
* **Hands\-on experience with Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) and Modularization.**
* **Hands\-on experience with Git and Version Control** practices.
* **Hands\-on experience with Unit Testing.**
* Practical experience with **CI/CD pipelines** and software development practices.
* Good level of **written and spoken English**.

**3\. Good\-to\-Have Skills**
-----------------------------

* Experience with **Azure Databricks**.
* Experience with **Azure Machine Learning**, particularly **Jobs and Pipelines**.
* Knowledge of **YAML configurations**.
* Hands\-on experience with **PySpark**.
* Familiarity with **Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar task management tools**.

* Resolve complex production issues escalations and keep critical automations running.
* Improve monitoring, logging, and resilience of automations on the Convergence platform.
